name: Parking Design Studio
tagline: Auto-lay-out multi-level basement parking and see car counts and clearances per level.
description: Generates a 2D basement parking layout from a site footprint and level count, and shows it as an exploded 3D stacked-basement view with car counts and clear-height data per level, exportable to DXF/PDF.

page.objective: Check whether a basement parking count and clearance target is achievable before committing to a scheme.
page.problem: Stacking multiple basement parking levels and confirming car counts and clearances by hand is slow and easy to get wrong across levels.
page.solution: A site footprint and level count auto-generate a 2D layout and an exploded 3D stack showing car counts and clear heights per level together.

highlights.headline: An exploded, level-by-level basement stack with live car counts and clearances.
points: Lays out parking bays in 2D from a site footprint and basement level count.
Shows the stack as an exploded 3D view across multiple basement levels, with car counts and clear heights per level.
Exports the layout to DXF/PDF with parking-bay dimensions intact.
